selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
Effective: 12 March 2019

## 14. Assignment

Helion Robotics Ltd. may not assign this agreement without prior written notice to the provider. Notice is required; consent is not required for assignment to an affiliate.

selection_rationale: Assignment section is the primary locus for prohibitions on assignment to a competitor; excerpt supplies verbatim language to test whether the contract forbids competitor assignment.
known_missing_information: No standalone competitor-assignment heading; negative finding may require reading absence across full contract body.
